candidate_grammar.boundary: Every supplied positive finite GEOM-008 configuration with point, relation, orientation and successor boundaries retained.
candidate_grammar.generator: Generate the complete eight-axis GEOM-008 product before observation access.
candidate_grammar.unique_survivor: GEOM-008 uniquely retains exact-geometric-decision-predicates, complete configuration custody, root forcing, post-registry observation and no extra rule.

excluded_inputs: no imported continuum geometry, theorem answer, fitted parameter or opaque solver selects the law
host 0 displays absence or counts artifacts only; it is not an SFT number object
no negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof scalar
no completed continuum manifold or infinite tessellation
no failed route retires an obligation or changes protected authority
statement: A computational geometry predicate is an exact finite comparison whose boundary and tie behavior are registered before evaluation.
title: Computational geometry predicates
